description: Build templates 21-30: Beauty/skincare and wellness categories. Each must have distinct visual identity.
steps: Create templates/beauty-serum/ - Serum product hero with elegant gradient and ingredient highlights
Create templates/cosmetic/ - Cosmetics campaign with multi-product arrangement and swatches
Create templates/skincare-101/ - Educational skincare post with numbered steps layout
Create templates/natural-essentials/ - Natural-product collection with botanical/organic feel
Create templates/bathroom-essentials/ - Lifestyle product set with bathroom scene grid
Create templates/blue-skincare/ - Clinical skincare ad with cool blue tones and lab-style layout
Create templates/facial-serum/ - Premium serum campaign with centered bottle and radial glow
Create templates/skin-serum/ - Ingredient/benefit ad with split panel showing ingredients and results
Create templates/elegant-relaxation-therapy/ - Wellness service with spa imagery and calm typography
Create templates/fitness-coach/ - Coach/service lead ad with trainer photo area and service list
Each template MUST include: manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md
Beauty templates should feel premium/luxurious; wellness templates should feel calm/inviting
acceptance_criteria: 30 total template directories exist under templates/
No JavaScript in any HTML file
All CSS uses only semantic variables
All text nodes have data-role and data-importance
verification: ls templates/ | wc -l should show at least 30
